## Automated Tests Required

### S12-02 — Pillar 3 OR Pillar 4 player-facing demonstration (Integration tier)

**Status**: this is the ONLY sprint-12 story requiring net-new automated test files. All other claude-owned stories are Config/Data type and rely on existing test suite preservation (1236/1236 baseline).

**Test file path** (depends on Option A/B decision at story-readiness):
- **Option A (Pillar 4 atmospheric moment — recommended)**: `tests/integration/feature/destiny_branch/pillar_demo_atmospheric_test.gd` OR `tests/integration/feature/battle_hud/pillar_demo_reserved_color_test.gd`
- **Option B (Pillar 3 narrative beat)**: `tests/integration/scenario_runner/pillar_demo_narrative_beat_test.gd` (depends on Story Event #10 stub OR BeatCue schema landing)

**What to test (Option A, recommended baseline)**:
- 운명 분기 reserved-color treatment (주홍 vermillion OR 금색 gold) appears at the demo branch resolution moment in chapter-prototype scene
- Reserved-color application is gated on the destiny-branch outcome being canonical-history-changing per ADR-0018 + design/gdd/destiny-branch.md F-DB-2 reserved_color_treatment derivation
- Audio cue (synthesized OR sourced asset) fires CONNECT_DEFERRED at the resolution boundary; cue subscriber's handler captures the trigger
- Reduced-motion accessibility toggle replaces the visual treatment with a static frame per `design/ux/accessibility-requirements.md` §2 (no skipping of the destiny signal)
- Reduce-haptics accessibility toggle is no-op for atmospheric visual+audio (haptic emitters are battle-hud forecast/feedback domain, not atmospheric)
- Demo path is reachable via the chapter-prototype start → destiny-branch resolution path WITHOUT developer guidance (this is the player-facing-demonstration criterion CD will evaluate at next gate-check)

**What to test (Option B alternative)**:
- Hero death event in chapter-1 scenario triggers Pillar 3 weight beat (echo mark archived + flag-set fired + dialogue/visual surface)
- BeatCue payload conforms to Story Event #10 stub schema (or the version landed at story-readiness time)
- Beat is reachable via the chapter-prototype start → first hero death path
- Reduced-motion + audio accessibility toggles handled per Intermediate tier

**Edge cases to cover**:
- **Reserved-color discipline boundary**: demo MUST NOT use 주홍/금색 in the baseline state (only at the destiny-branch resolution moment); per art-bible §1 + accessibility-requirements.md §4 R-1
- **Cross-platform color rendering**: macOS Metal + Linux Vulkan + Windows D3D12 should each render the reserved color identically; if discrepancy, flag as ADVISORY (not BLOCKING — POLISH-tier per CI lane gap binding decision in `production/decisions/ci-lane-gap-decision-2026-05-07.md`)
- **Demo idempotency**: re-entering the chapter-prototype scene from main menu and re-running the demo path produces the same atmospheric treatment (no state leak)
- **Audio cue absence fallback**: if the audio asset is missing, the visual treatment alone must convey the destiny signal (per accessibility-requirements.md §4 R-1 alternate-channel encoding)

**Estimated test count**: ~3-5 integration tests (1 happy path + 2-3 edge case + 1 accessibility toggle). Single integration test file.

**GDD references**:
- `design/gdd/destiny-branch.md` rev 1.3.2 §F-DB-2 reserved_color_treatment derivation
- `design/gdd/game-concept.md` Pillar 3 (영웅의 무게) + Pillar 4 (삼국지의 숨결)
- `design/ux/accessibility-requirements.md` §4 R-1 reserved-color alternate encoding + §2 In Scope (Reduced motion / Reduce haptics toggles)
- `design/art/art-bible.md` §1 Visual Identity + §3 reserved-color discipline

**ADR references**: ADR-0018 (DestinyBranch judge — already Accepted at sprint-7); ADR-0015 (BattleHUD — already Accepted at sprint-7); ADR-0001 (GameBus signal contract for audio cue dispatch)

## Manual QA Checklist

### S12-02 — Pillar 3/4 player-facing demonstration

**Verification method**: Manual playtest in chapter-prototype + screenshot evidence + CD sign-off
**Who must sign off**: creative-director (CD) — this directly addresses CD's CONCERNS verdict at gate-check 2026-05-08
**Evidence to capture**:
- Screenshot/video of demo path executed start-to-finish
- Notes documenting which Pillar (3 OR 4) the demo addresses
- Notes documenting the "without developer guidance" criterion (CD-flagged in path-to-PASS)
- Reserved-color treatment screenshots in baseline + reserved + reduced-motion states (Option A)
- Audio cue subjective evaluation: does it convey the destiny signal?

**Checklist** (Option A — Pillar 4 atmospheric moment):
- [ ] Demo path is reachable via chapter-prototype start without developer guidance (player can find it)
- [ ] Reserved color (주홍 OR 금색) appears ONLY at the destiny-branch resolution moment (not in baseline)
- [ ] Reduced-motion toggle replaces the visual treatment with a static frame (does NOT skip the signal)
- [ ] Audio cue fires at the resolution boundary and is subjectively appropriate to the moment
- [ ] Three Kingdoms atmospheric tone is recognizable in the demo (target: a non-developer player can identify "this is a Three Kingdoms moment")
- [ ] Demo path is idempotent (re-entering produces consistent treatment)
- [ ] CD reviews the demo and provides verdict: PASS / NEEDS REVISION / FAIL

**Checklist** (Option B — Pillar 3 narrative beat):
- [ ] Hero death event triggers a recognizable Pillar 3 weight moment (echo mark + flag + dialogue/visual)
- [ ] Beat is reachable via chapter-prototype start without developer guidance
- [ ] BeatCue / Story Event payload conforms to schema (per S12-02 story-readiness decision on stub-vs-full-Story-Event)
- [ ] CD reviews and verdicts as Option A

**Sign-off requirement**: Playtest notes for S12-02 must be written to `production/session-logs/playtest-sprint-12-pillar-demo-[date].md` (NEW directory may be required) AND reviewed by creative-director before S12-02 can be marked COMPLETE. ## Definition of Done — Sprint-12

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

### All claude-owned stories (S12-01..S12-09)
- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified per story file's Acceptance Criteria section
- [ ] Test files exist at specified paths for Logic/Integration stories (S12-02 mandatory; S12-04 + S12-09 conditional)
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for any UI / Visual-Feel components (S12-02 only)
- [ ] sprint-status.yaml row updated to status=done with changelog comment (200-byte hygiene)
- [ ] EPIC.md + index.md propagation per /story-done Phase 7 (codified S11-03)
- [ ] Code reviewed (auto-pass for doc-only Config/Data stories; explicit `/code-review` invocation for S12-02 if Integration test ships)

### S12-10 + S12-11 USER-OWNED
- [ ] User attestation captured per refusal-to-fabricate posture (no claude write without explicit user input)
- [ ] If S12-06 codifies a 5th-time threshold rule (S7-11 → S12-10), apply that rule explicitly at sprint-12 retro

### Sprint-12 Close Gate (S12-03 dependency chain)
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` → `production/qa/smoke-sprint-12-[date].md` per S11-10 naming)
- [ ] QA sign-off report: APPROVED or APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS (run `/team-qa sprint-12-close` OR attestation-mode for doc-only majority)
- [ ] No S1 or S2 bugs in delivered features
- [ ] Sprint-12 retrospective authored at `production/retrospectives/retro-sprint-12-[date].md`
- [ ] **`/gate-check pre-prod-to-prod` re-run** — verdict documented; `production/stage.txt` written if PASS
- [ ] All Must-Have stories (S12-01 + S12-02 + S12-03) complete
